name: pre-commit-security
description: Pre-commit hook that blocks commits containing hardcoded secrets or known vulnerability patterns

block_patterns.name: hardcoded_jwt_secret
block_patterns.message: Hardcoded JWT secret detected. Use environment variables instead.

block_patterns.name: hardcoded_api_key
block_patterns.message: Hardcoded API key detected. Use a secrets manager.

block_patterns.name: plaintext_password
block_patterns.message: Plaintext password in source. Use bcrypt or argon2.

block_patterns.name: sql_string_concat
block_patterns.message: SQL query with string interpolation. Use parameterized queries.

block_patterns.name: dangerously_set_inner_html
block_patterns.message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML detected. Ensure content is sanitized.

block_patterns.name: eval_usage
block_patterns.message: eval() detected. This is a code injection risk.

block_patterns.name: cors_wildcard
block_patterns.message: CORS wildcard origin. Restrict to specific domains.

on_block.message: Commit blocked by security hook. Fix the issues above and try again.
